text:
maria (AE): Quick sync — on call with NewBank. They want SSO + automated provisioning + RBAC for a 2-week POC. Main asks: SAML metadata endpoint, SCIM v2 group sync, domain verification for tenant isolation, and pricing for hosted vs dedicated for ~5–7M tokens/day. Also sent security questionnaire (red flag items: data residency, KMS, audit logs). Can eng/security advise on gaps?

chris (SE): Thanks. Short answers: we support both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated SAML. Metadata URL we provide: `https://redwood.api/saml/metadata/<tenant>` (will be tenant-specific). For SCIM we support v2, incremental delta, and group sync — need to confirm primary group -> role mapping schema.

anya (Security): Saw the questionnaire. Key blockers: 1) customer asks for proof of encryption keys managed in their KMS — we support customer KMS via Redwood Private only (not hosted). 2) Data residency: hosted regions are NA/EU; if they need on-prem/data residency we should propose Private. 3) Audit logs: we can provide event export, retention tiers are configurable but needs SRE to enable for the POC.

zack (Solutions Eng): Pricing note — for a short POC at 5–7M tokens/day: hosted API estimate ~$3k–5k/day (variable), Dedicated (reserved pool) has a minimum monthly commit and is ~40–60% cheaper at steady state. I'll run numbers once we know expected concurrency and seq length. Also: if they require KMS or private networking, that pushes to Private (enterprise licensing).

joe.newbank: To confirm — we'll be on Azure AD, prefer IdP-initiated SSO, need SCIM push for users + groups, and want role mapping like `scim.groups -> app.roles`. Also we need domain proofing: can you accept DNS TXT or org-verified claims?

chris (SE): DNS TXT is fine for domain ownership verification. For role mapping we can accept a SCIM group->role mapping file during POC; minimal schema we need: `[{"groupName":"engineering","role":"dev"}]`. We'll add support for custom attribute name if they want.

anya (Security): For KMS: if they want customer-managed keys we need Private deployment. For hosted, we offer server-side encryption with provider keys only. Also will need to hand over the security questionnaire sections 2.1 (encryption) and 4.2 (auditability) to infra to fill.

maria (AE): Action items: 1) chris — prepare SAML metadata + SCIM sample mapping file, 2) zack — rough hosted vs dedicated cost table for 2-week POC + steady-state projection, 3) anya — mark which questionnaire items force Private/KMS. 4) I'll ask customer if DNS TXT is acceptable and get a sample IdP metadata. Target: get everything before Mon.

deploy-bot: Created INF-4321: "NewBank POC — idp/scim/domain verification" (assignee: chris).

chris (SE): I'll drop the metadata and mapping by EOD. SAMPLE mapping (inline): `[{"groupName":"sre","role":"oncall"},{"groupName":"eng","role":"developer"}]`

zack (Solutions Eng): For pricing I'll put two scenarios (light: 5M tokens/day, heavy: 7M tokens/day) and include delta if Private/KMS required. Expect draft in ~4 hours. :thumbsup:

joe.newbank: DNS TXT is fine. I'll get our IdP metadata and a contact (iam-admin@newbank.com). Thanks all.

maria (AE): Great — if anyone hits a blocker ping me and I'll escalate to CS/Legal. :eyes:
